sending.poolsHelp: Organisations send from the addresses of their pool (or the default pool). An address is used only when its PTR record names its HELO and resolves back to it. New addresses warm up: their daily limit rises over about six weeks.

sending.heloHelp: Must equal the PTR record of the address, and resolve back to it.
sending.warmupHelp: Recommended for a new address: about 50 messages the first day, more each day after.
sending.tlsHelp: Outcome of TLS per receiving domain and policy (MTA-STS, DANE or none). Domains that publish a TLS-RPT address get a daily report.

locks.help: Sending stops on its own for an account whose mail bounces or is reported as spam far more than normal - often a sign the account was taken over. Check the account (password, sessions, forwarding rules) before letting it send again.
